title: 第18章 魅姬
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“小陆，不必介怀的！”

    “师姐是你的女人，你想干嘛就干嘛，不要板着脸了嘛！”姜怀玉满脸的温柔。

    此刻，她身上的伤痕已经尽数恢复，毕竟是金丹修士，皮外伤还是很好治的。

    之所以故意留着，也是为了彻底和王峰断了。

    “你可以让我一个人静静吗？”

    看着跟出来的姜怀玉，陆沉一脸的无奈。

    “抱歉，不可以哦，师姐知道你心情不好，怕你做出伤害自己的事情……所以，我要让你变得虚弱，来不及去想这些糟心事！”

    说完，姜怀玉便抱住陆沉的腰，往房间里走。

    是的，她上瘾了。

    如果说昨晚还是喜欢陆沉的话，现在她是爱。

    她从没想过，陆沉竟然如此的天赋异禀，天生的至尊骨如此强大！

    “不是，被子怎么让庄静白给偷走了？她自己不会买吗？”

    ……

    一连好几天，陆沉都在自己的洞府里和姜怀玉一起闭关。

    他不想这样，但姜怀玉实在是太强，他根本就没有还手的余地。

    直到有一天，林天亲自登门拜访。

    “师弟，怎么几天不见，你就胖了一圈啊，一个人躲在家里偷吃？”

    “咳咳，哪有的事！师兄你找我是有什么事吗？”陆沉连忙岔开话题。

    没办法，他这几天被姜怀玉这个富婆养的太好了，每天灵米，大鱼大肉的伺候，还有鲍鱼饭，他能不胖吗？

    “哦，我这不是感觉在宗门里太压抑了嘛，我就想着带王师兄一起出去散散心，问你去不去。”

    “去！我必须去！他出了这么大的事，我肯定得陪着啊，要是他想不开……”

    陆沉说着，还心虚的看了眼客房。

    不过好在里面的人没什么反应，他这才脱离魔窟。

    很快，两人就来到了炼丹峰上，王峰此刻也早已等候多时。

    张帆并没有来，不知道有什么事。

    见人都到齐，林天也不墨迹，拿出自己的飞舟，和两人一起乘坐了上去。

    飞舟在云层中穿行，很快就越过了正道联盟的边界。

    陆沉站在船头，看着远处若隐若现的城池，心里隐隐觉得不对劲。

    这地儿怎么是魔门的地盘啊？林天在搞什么？

    “师兄，咱们这是要去哪儿？”

    林天闻言嘿嘿一笑，神秘兮兮地压低声音：“到了你就知道了。”
content_en:
"Xiao Lu, don't worry about it!"

"Senior sister is your woman, you can do whatever you want, don't be so stern!" Jiang Huaiyu's face was full of gentleness.

At this moment, all the scars on her body have been healed. After all, she is a golden elixir monk, and skin injuries can still be easily cured.

The reason why he deliberately kept it was to completely break up with Wang Feng.

"Can you leave me alone?"

Looking at Jiang Huaiyu who followed him out, Lu Chen looked helpless.

"Sorry, you can't. Senior sister knows that you are in a bad mood and is afraid that you will do something to hurt yourself... So, I want to make you weak so that you don't have time to think about these bad things!"

After saying that, Jiang Huaiyu hugged Lu Chen's waist and walked into the room.

Yes, she is addicted.

If she still liked Lu Chen last night, now she loves him.

She had never thought that Lu Chen was so talented and his innate Supreme Bone was so powerful!

"No, why did Zhuang Jingbai steal the quilt? Doesn't she know how to buy it herself?"

…

For several days, Lu Chen stayed in seclusion with Jiang Huaiyu in his cave.

He didn't want to do this, but Jiang Huaiyu was so strong that he had no room to fight back.

Until one day, Lin Tian came to visit in person.

"Junior brother, why have you gained weight after not seeing each other for a few days? Are you hiding at home alone and eating secretly?"

"Ahem, what's the matter? Senior brother, do you have any business with me?" Lu Chen quickly changed the subject.

There is no way, he has been raised so well by Jiang Huaiyu, a rich woman, every day. He is fed rice, fish and meat, and abalone rice. How can he not get fat?

"Oh, don't I feel too depressed in the sect? I just wanted to take Senior Brother Wang out to relax and ask you if you want to go."

"Go! I have to go! If something big happens to him, I must accompany him. If he can't think about it..."

Lu Chen said, and glanced at the guest room with a guilty conscience.

Fortunately, there was no reaction from the people inside, so he escaped from the devil's cave.

Soon, the two arrived at the Alchemy Peak, and Wang Feng had been waiting for a long time.

Zhang Fan didn't come, I don't know what happened.

Seeing that everyone was here, Lin Tian took out his flying boat and rode on it with the two of them without hesitation.

The flying boat passed through the clouds and soon crossed the border of the Righteous Alliance.

Lu Chen stood on the bow of the ship, looking at the looming city in the distance, feeling something was wrong.

Why is this place the territory of the Demon Sect?What is Lin Tian doing?

"Brother, where are we going?"

Lin Tian chuckled upon hearing this and lowered his voice mysteriously: "You'll know when we get there."
